claim: Acceptance-plan section 5 step 1 (read-only, execution disabled) against a signed-in IBKR paper IB Gateway: the official ibapi client probe returned status 'passed' and the NautilusTrader 2.0.0rc5 native adapter probe returned 'passed'. Partial evidence only: this is step 1 of 4; steps 2-4 need Nautilus native paper stock orders, which are blocked upstream (see blockers).
plan_history: plan.json was written before the first run (file time 2026-09-22T22:01:09Z) and is kept verbatim; it was not independently reviewed before the run.
deviations_from_plan: Client: the hand-rolled TWS protocol probe the plan names failed its handshake; the official ibapi client (ibapi_probe.py) replaced it, and the NautilusTrader native historical client (nautilus_probe.py) covers contract identity and bars.
Client ids 73 (ibapi) and 76 (Nautilus) instead of the planned 71.
Receipts: evidence/ and evidence/receipts/ instead of the plan's receipt_path, which is the gate's flip receipt; both probes now refuse to write there.
Bars: the ibapi probe requests 2 D of 5-minute TRADES bars (useRTH=1); the Nautilus probe requests 1-DAY-LAST and 5-MINUTE-LAST over 5 D; the plan named 1-DAY over 5 days.

Timeouts: ibapi overall deadline 90 s (plan overall_timeout_seconds) with per-request waits of 5-20 s; Nautilus per-call timeout 20 s (plan per_call_timeout_seconds) plus a 5 s TCP pre-check. The first committed version (b67bf15) used 60 s and 30 s.
Quote age: applied from the fixed version on, as last-trade timestamp against server time with a 2 s one-second-resolution allowance; the first committed version did not check it.
Data mode: the plan declared DELAYED; the published run was granted REALTIME (the plan records whatever is granted).

blockers.scope: conditional: sessions where IB sends notice 2188, as with delayed data
blockers.effect: rc5's Rust ibapi =3.3.0 classifies IB notice 2188 as a hard error, so a native historical request that receives it returns an error and drops the bars
blockers.observed: one native failure, 13:18-13:19Z, from an ad hoc script (retained in evidence/attempts); its data mode is inferred as DELAYED from the ibapi run two minutes earlier; confounded by a different script and pre-market timing; the REALTIME runs saw no 2188 on the ibapi connection and native bars returned
blockers.source: rc5 Cargo.toml pins ibapi = "=3.3.0"; https://github.com/wboayue/rust-ibapi/issues/764 fixed by #765 (9d97926) in v4.0.0
blockers.unblock: a NautilusTrader release with ibapi >= 4.0.0 (open PR https://github.com/nautechsystems/nautilus_trader/pull/5041 pins =4.1.0)

blockers.effect: Nautilus native stock orders are denied locally (venue IB never matches SMART)
blockers.unblock: an upstream fix at the pinned release

limitations: Read-only step 1 only; acceptance-plan steps 2-4 (client-id ownership, bounded paper orders, reconnect/restart reconciliation) are not run.

Market-data type depends on the session: DELAYED at 13:16Z (pre-market), none during a competing session at 13:23Z (10197), REALTIME from 14:13Z; a delayed quote never satisfies a case that needs a current real-time feed.
Quote age uses IB's last-trade timestamp and server time, both at one-second resolution.

The paper-account check comes from the ibapi probe; the Nautilus historical client has no account query of its own, so the Nautilus probe cannot verify account scope on its own connection and relies on an ibapi receipt for the same host and port written at most 300 s earlier.
One session on one host (Windows IB Gateway 10.50 reached from WSL over mirrored networking); not a new-host acceptance.
Account ids are not recorded, not even hashed; balances are not recorded.
